User_Story: As an HR admin, I want to register an employee with a manager and starting leave balances so that they can request time off.
Notes: Prisma domain. status ACTIVE/INACTIVE/ON_LEAVE; annual + sick balances; self-FK managerId.

User_Story: As an HR admin, I want adding an employee to provision their login via an email invite so that new staff can sign in and request leave.
Notes: Provisioning. employee.create calls auth admin-create/invite (sync cross-service, getOutboundHeaders #24); stores userId link. Apply sync-cross-service-call skill.

User_Story: As an HR admin, I want an Add employee modal capturing name, email, department, manager and starting balances so that I can onboard staff in one step.
Notes: Modal form; on submit creates employee + triggers the invite. data-testid: create-employee-form.

User_Story: As an HR admin, I want to maintain a public-holiday calendar so that leave-day counts exclude holidays.
As an employee, I want to submit a leave request for a date range and type so that my manager can approve it.
Notes: Prisma domain. Persist DRAFT. leaveType ANNUAL/SICK/UNPAID. days excludes weekends+holidays. Actor from @CurrentUser (#23).

User_Story: As an HR admin, I want to list leave requests filtered by status and employee so that I can audit the queue.
As the system, I want submitting a request to synchronously verify the employee is ACTIVE, has a manager, and has enough balance before persisting so that invalid requests never enter the queue.
Notes: ACL — apply sync-cross-service-call skill. IEmployeeValidator validates status + manager + balance. getOutboundHeaders() (#24). Golden Rule #14.

User_Story: As the system, I want a submitted request to reserve the employee's leave balance asynchronously so that overlapping requests cannot overspend the balance.
Notes: Saga step 1 — apply choreography-saga skill. leave publishes LEAVE_REQUEST_SUBMITTED; employee-event-handler runs ReserveLeaveBalanceUseCase (transactional); replies BALANCE_RESERVED | BALANCE_INSUFFICIENT. Idempotent.

User_Story: As an employee, I want my request to move to pending approval or be rejected automatically when the balance check returns so that I know where I stand.
Notes: Saga step 2. leave-event-handler consumes BALANCE_RESERVED/BALANCE_INSUFFICIENT; DRAFT->PENDING_APPROVAL | REJECTED. Replay = no-op.

User_Story: As a manager, I want to approve or reject a pending request so that the employee's balance is deducted or released.
Notes: On approve publish LEAVE_APPROVED; employee handler deducts reserved balance + sets ON_LEAVE. Only assigned managerId may approve.

User_Story: As an employee, I want a webapp page to submit a leave request and see my balance so that I can self-serve.
Notes: Form via react-hook-form + Zod from @old-st/contracts/leave. Client hooks in client-common.

User_Story: As a manager, I want a webapp approval queue with status badges and approve/reject actions so that I can process requests quickly.
Notes: Thin-orchestrator page + data-table + status-variants.ts + action menu. data-testid: leave-requests-table.

User_Story: As an HR admin, I want a webapp employee directory with balances so that I can manage staff.
As an employee, I want a mobile screen to request leave and check my balance so that I can apply from anywhere.
Notes: Reuses client-common hooks. Expo screen + form. Note: + mobile.
